# forumulate_page (Resource)

A page of a docs-style space, written in Markdown. The body is sent through the API's Markdown support and converted to the same blocks the editor makes; the resource then publishes it (or leaves it a draft). Its place in the tree (`collection_id`, `parent_id`, `after_id`), its kind (`preset`) and its metadata (SEO, navigation, tags) are managed too.

Drift is detected in the body (compared by the API's own normalised Markdown, so a list marker the API rewrites is not a diff), the title, the slug, the place in the tree, the publish state and the metadata keys you declare. Destroying a page moves it to the trash; `destroy_on_delete` makes that permanent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_page" "quickstart" {
  space_id      = forumulate_space.docs.id
  collection_id = forumulate_collection.guides.id
  slug          = "quickstart"
  title         = "Quickstart"

  body = <<-MD
    Create a space, then publish your first page.

    ```sh
    forumulate publish ./docs
    ```
  MD

  metadata = {
    tags            = ["intro"]
    seo_title       = "Quickstart | Acme Docs"
    seo_description = "Publish your first page in five minutes."
    nav_title       = "Start"
  }

  metadata_json = jsonencode({
    layout = "wide"
  })
}

# A draft: written, not published.
resource "forumulate_page" "wip" {
  space_id      = forumulate_space.docs.id
  collection_id = forumulate_collection.guides.id
  slug          = "wip"
  title         = "Work in progress"
  body          = file("${path.module}/wip.md")
  published     = false
}

# Nested under another page, placed after a sibling.
resource "forumulate_page" "install" {
  space_id      = forumulate_space.docs.id
  collection_id = forumulate_collection.guides.id
  slug          = "install"
  title         = "Install"
  parent_id     = forumulate_page.quickstart.id
  body          = "Install the CLI with `npm i -g @forumulate/cli`."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection_id` (String) The collection the page lives in (its id). Changing it moves the page.
- `slug` (String) The page's address segment (1 to 80 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). A slug already taken in the collection is an error, never a silent suffix.
- `space_id` (String) The space (its id or slug). Changing it replaces the page.
- `title` (String) The page's title, 1 to 300 characters.

### Optional

- `after_id` (String) Place the page directly after this sibling (its id). Changing it reorders; the API does not return a page's order, so drift is not detected.
- `body` (String) The page's Markdown (up to 2,000,000 characters), without the leading `# Title` line. See the Markdown dialect in the API docs for directives and snippets.
- `destroy_on_delete` (Boolean) On destroy, permanently delete the page after trashing it, freeing its slug. Defaults to `false`: the page stays in the trash, restorable.
- `locale` (String) The page's language: `default` (the space's source language) or a code the space declares. Changing it replaces the page.
- `metadata` (Attributes) The common page metadata. Only the attributes you set are managed; removing one clears it. Everything else is `metadata_json`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `metadata_json` (String) Page metadata beyond the `metadata` attribute: `fields` (the space type's declared fields), `audience`, `layout`, `hero`, `badge`, `template`, `themePatch`, and the rest of `PATCH …/pages/{id}/metadata`. Keys are camelCase, as the API spells them. A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `parent_id` (String) The page this one nests under (its id, in the same collection); leave out for top level.
- `preset` (String) The kind of piece this page is (one the space declares; `GET /space-types/{type}`). Changing it is validated by the API against the kind's shape.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether readers see the page. `true` (the default) publishes after every change; `false` keeps it a draft and unpublishes a live page.
- `version_key` (String) The docs version the page belongs to (up to 40 characters). Defaults to the current version. Changing it replaces the page.

### Read-Only

- `body_hash` (String) SHA-256 of the API's normalised Markdown for the page, used to tell a real edit made in the studio from the API's rewriting of your Markdown.
- `content_hash` (String) The API's `contentHash` of the published body.
- `id` (String) The page's id (a UUID).
- `updated_at` (String) When the page last changed.
- `url` (String) The page's public address, when it has one.

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Optional:

- `canonical_url` (String) The canonical URL when it is not the page's own address.
- `cover_url` (String) A cover image: an uploaded path or an http(s) URL.
- `hide_from_nav` (Boolean) Leave the page out of the sidebar.
- `icon` (String) A named icon or a custom icon (path, URL, emoji).
- `nav_title` (String) A shorter title for the sidebar (up to 80 characters).
- `noindex` (Boolean) Ask search engines not to index the page.
- `search_exclude` (Boolean) Leave the page out of search.
- `seo_description` (String) The meta description (up to 400 characters).
- `seo_title` (String) The `<title>` (up to 200 characters).
- `tags` (Set of String) Up to 12 tags, 60 characters each.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_page.quickstart docs/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
